parts.name: beam body

physics.Basic_description: Long, slender silver metallic bar forming the main backbone of the tool.
physics.Functional_description: Provides the rigid reference scale and track for the sliding jaw.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the mid-section of the beam firmly to stabilize the tool.
physics.reason: Caliper beams are typically machined from solid stainless steel stock for rigidity.

parts.description: Long, slender silver metallic bar forming the main backbone of the tool.
parts.function: Provides the rigid reference scale and track for the sliding jaw.

parts.name: beam scale

physics.Basic_description: Flat surface on the beam with printed measurement graduations.
physics.Functional_description: Displays the main measurement scale for reading values.
physics.Grasped_description: Not a grasp target; avoid obscuring the scale during use.
physics.reason: This is a surface feature on the solid beam.

parts.description: Flat surface on the beam with printed measurement graduations.
parts.function: Displays the main measurement scale for reading values.

parts.name: main scale ticks

physics.Basic_description: Fine etched or printed lines indicating measurement increments.
physics.Functional_description: Allows precise reading of the measurement along the beam.
physics.reason: Surface markings on the solid beam.

parts.description: Fine etched or printed lines indicating measurement increments.
parts.function: Allows precise reading of the measurement along the beam.

parts.name: fixed jaw

physics.Basic_description: Silver metallic L-shaped block at the left end of the beam.
physics.Functional_description: Acts as the stationary reference surface for measuring external dimensions.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the fixed jaw body to hold the caliper steady against an object.
physics.reason: Jaws are solid metal blocks to withstand clamping forces.

parts.description: Silver metallic L-shaped block at the left end of the beam.
parts.function: Acts as the stationary reference surface for measuring external dimensions.

parts.name: slider body

physics.Basic_description: Dark grey blocky component that slides along the beam.
physics.Functional_description: Carries the moving jaw and dial mechanism along the scale.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the slider body to move the jaw or position the tool.
physics.reason: The slider is a carriage that wraps around the beam, implying a hollow shell structure.

parts.description: Dark grey blocky component that slides along the beam.
parts.function: Carries the moving jaw and dial mechanism along the scale.

parts.name: lock screw boss

physics.Basic_description: Small raised cylindrical feature on the slider for the lock screw.
physics.Functional_description: Houses the threading for the lock screw mechanism.
physics.reason: Likely a solid molded feature or thick wall section of the slider.

parts.description: Small raised cylindrical feature on the slider for the lock screw.
parts.function: Houses the threading for the lock screw mechanism.

parts.name: depth rod

physics.Basic_description: Thin silver metallic rod extending from the right end of the beam.
physics.Functional_description: Extends to measure the depth of holes or steps.
physics.Grasped_description: Do not grasp; too thin and fragile for gripping.
physics.reason: Depth rods are solid thin metal wires or rods.

parts.description: Thin silver metallic rod extending from the right end of the beam.
parts.function: Extends to measure the depth of holes or steps.

parts.name: lock screw head

physics.Basic_description: Tiny dark knob or screw head at the end of the lock mechanism.
physics.Functional_description: Turned to lock or unlock the slider position.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small for a standard gripper; requires fine manipulation.
physics.reason: Screw heads are solid metal components.

parts.description: Tiny dark knob or screw head at the end of the lock mechanism.
parts.function: Turned to lock or unlock the slider position.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained

simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)
